scope: Additive permanent Snake Bracelet L1-27 and spawned Snake L1-10 audit; exclude the temporary Snake Barrel and its different Snake variant.
game_version: Official 2025-02 equipment release; claimed client build 18.600.3 on 2026-09-16; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Current spawned-unit build not verified.

sources.title: Snake Festival: Lunar New Year Medal Event!
facts: Snake Bracelet is Barbarian King Epic Equipment and summons snakes that fight beside him when he takes damage.
The article separately labels Snake Barrel as a temporary event troop; its snakes are not the permanent Equipment child.
sources.limitations: No damage threshold, cap, child statistics, spawn placement, event ordering or Hero defeat behavior is specified.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: The Home Village Hero equipment table assigns Snake Bracelet to the Barbarian King.
sources.limitations: The support table does not provide combat values or Snake behavior.

sources.title: Snake Bracelet — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: TH18 maximum is L27. The public table's per-level Hero HP and DPS boosts, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements agree with the pinned payload.
sources.limitations: The public table omits Snake cap, Snake level, attack speed boost and damage-trigger implementation. Its claimed build does not verify the child-unit values.

sources.title: Pinned Snake Bracelet Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: All 27 rows retain maxSummonedSnakes, snakeLevel, dpsIncrease, attackSpeedIncrease and Hero hitpointIncrease. The pinned cap ranges from 11 to 54 and child level from 1 to 10.
sources.limitations: The file has no damage threshold or Snake entity statistics. A limit on total summons cannot be assumed to mean simultaneous live cap.

sources.title: Snake Bracelet/Snake
facts: The indexed page distinguishes Bracelet Snakes from temporary Snake Barrel Snakes and gives ten child levels with HP and DPS, ground-only attacks and Wall jumping.
Its prose says one Snake is summoned for every 300 damage taken by the Barbarian King.
sources.limitations: The page could not be fetched directly during this audit; only a search excerpt was available. Publication and current game version are unknown. The 300-damage rule lacks mitigation, excess-damage, heal and same-tick semantics. No current-build child-stat confirmation was found.

observations.note: These are pinned historical level fields. The child entity and total-versus-live cap semantics are not confirmed in a dated current-build source.
Undated indexed secondary observation only. Do not materialize or mix with temporary Snake Barrel Snake values.

derivations.result: Retain Hero HP, DPS, ore cost and Blacksmith data only
derivations.method: Cross-check dated claimed-build table against the SHA-pinned normalized payload; no stat application or attack cadence is derived.

derivations.result: Create an unresolved child coverage row
derivations.method: Official source confirms a persistent Equipment summon; frozen level mapping reaches child L10, while the undated child excerpt gives an unverified stat table. Temporary Snake Barrel is excluded.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn one Snake every 300 raw damage to the King
rejected_inferences.reason: Only an undated secondary excerpt gives 300; raw versus post-mitigation damage, excess accumulation, shield interception and same-tick ordering are unknown.

rejected_inferences.rule: Interpret maxSummonedSnakes as live concurrent capacity
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned field does not say whether the cap is lifetime or simultaneous; the distinction affects future state.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use temporary Snake Barrel statistics or behavior for Bracelet Snakes
rejected_inferences.reason: The official article separates the temporary troop, and the child source explicitly distinguishes their variants.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the attack-speed percent directly to current Core attack interval
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned percent lacks the game's rounding and stacking stage and the dated public table does not corroborate it.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn at the King's center on the damage tick
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source defines placement, collision clearance, entity-ID creation order, or spawn phase.

items: current damage trigger threshold and whether raw, mitigated or lost HP counts
multiple Snakes per hit, overflow accumulation and healing interactions
total-versus-live cap and reset after revival or reassignment
damage, summon and King death tick order
Hero HP/DPS and attack-speed modifier rounding and stacking
Giant Gauntlet, Spiky Ball, Vampstache and Phoenix interactions
Viewer, snapshot, replay and RL loadout behavior
current child HP, DPS, cadence, range and movement by level
spawn position, collision and entity-ID order
target acquisition, Wall crossing, retargeting and damage timing
trap triggering, aura and Pet interaction
battlefield sprite, anchors and redistribution rights

conclusion: Snake Bracelet L1-27 and spawned Snake L1-10 are partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish a permanent King Equipment with damage-triggered snakes. The pinned level and cap mapping and undated child values do not define a current deterministic summon or child-combat contract.
